text: 开盘第一个小时，部分宽基ETF显著放量，中证1000ETF南方（512100）成交额近44亿元，超出上一日全天成交额，科创50ETF华夏（588000）、创业板ETF易方达（159915）、沪深300ETF华泰柏瑞（510300）成交额均超50亿元。
text_en: In the first hour of trading, some broad-based ETFs saw significant increases in volume. China Southern CSI 1000 ETF (512100) had turnover of nearly RMB 4.4 billion, exceeding its full-day turnover the previous day, while ChinaAMC STAR 50 ETF (588000), E Fund ChiNext ETF (159915) and Huatai-PineBridge CSI 300 ETF (510300) each had turnover exceeding RMB 5 billion.
